faq.html.before: Regular tutoring is billed in monthly blocks. Payment for the next block is due two days before its first session, and new students pay their first block before tutoring begins. Payment can be made by PayPal or bank transfer. A session can be cancelled without charge with at least 7 days’ notice. With at least 12 hours’ notice but less than 7 days, it can be rescheduled within four weeks, subject to availability. Cancellations with less than 12 hours’ notice and no-shows are charged and cannot be made up.
faq.html.after: Regular tutoring is prepaid in agreed blocks. Payment for a new block is due before the first lesson requiring that block, unless a different date is explicitly agreed. Your rate, currency and any separately charged marking or feedback will be confirmed in advance. Payment can be made by PayPal or bank transfer. Existing client agreements remain in effect. With at least 7 days’ notice, a session can be cancelled without charge. With at least 12 hours’ notice but less than 7 days, it can be rescheduled; the replacement must take place within four weeks of the original date, subject to mutually convenient availability. An unused replacement expires after those four weeks. Cancellations with less than 12 hours’ notice and no-shows normally incur the full session fee. Existing client agreements and any exceptions expressly agreed with Amanda remain in effect.

privacy-consent.html.before: Auxesis Education collects only the information needed to respond to an enquiry, arrange tutoring and manage the tutoring relationship. Depending on the situation, this may include a parent or guardian’s name, email address and phone number; the student’s first name and personal Gmail address; country, optional nationality and pronouns, and time zone; grade or year level; curriculum or programme; subject; learning goals or challenges; scheduling information; and whether tutoring is being requested for more than one student. During tutoring, this also includes lesson planning, lesson notes, resource links, messages, progress reports, invoices and payment records held in the private Auxesis Portal.
privacy-consent.html.after: Auxesis Education collects information needed to respond to enquiries, arrange tutoring and manage the tutoring relationship. This may include contact details for a parent, guardian or adult student; student name and personal Gmail address for lessons; country and time zone; year or level, curriculum, subject and learning goals; and scheduling preferences. Tutoring records may include lesson plans, notes, shared resources, correspondence, progress information, invoices and payments. You do not need a Gmail address to make an enquiry.

privacy-consent.html.before: Student phone numbers are not normally collected or used. Students communicate with me through their private message thread in the Auxesis Portal. Parents may choose to create a WhatsApp group after enrolment, and I am happy to participate, but WhatsApp is not a required student communication channel.
privacy-consent.html.after: Contact details are used for the communication method we agree on. Phone details on the enquiry form are optional unless you enter part of a phone contact number. Students can communicate by email or, where arranged, Google Chat. Parents may choose WhatsApp after enrolment; it is not a required student communication channel.

privacy-consent.html.before: The Auxesis Education website and live private Portal run on Cloudflare Pages and Workers. Cloudflare D1 stores Portal accounts, lesson records, messages, progress reports, invoices and payment records, as well as submitted reviews and their consent and moderation status. This describes record storage; it does not mean Cloudflare collects payments or stores every document used for tutoring. The live Portal no longer runs on Floot.
privacy-consent.html.after: Cloudflare hosts this website and processes technical request information needed to operate and protect it. Website reviews are stored with Cloudflare. The student portal is not currently offered as a working student service. Historical records containing real student information entered by Amanda during development and testing remain in restricted systems and recovery copies; these records have not been deleted. They were not entered through student use of the portal.

privacy-consent.html.before: Google provides Portal sign-in and processes the account information used to identify authorised users. Google Meet is used for live tutoring sessions. Google Calendar holds scheduling information, and the Google Sheets Student Tracker remains the authoritative billing record. Google Drive is used for shared lesson documents and privately stored recovery packages; these files are separate from the Cloudflare Portal database.
privacy-consent.html.after: Google services are used for tutoring and private administration, including Google Meet for lessons, Drive for shared teaching documents and restricted records, email and agreed Google Chat communications, and scheduling and billing records. Access to private business and student records is restricted. Technical service providers, including GitHub for controlled website maintenance, may temporarily process recovery information; private records are not published in the public website repository.

privacy-consent.html.before: The Portal uses necessary sign-in and session cookies. Cloudflare processes technical request information to deliver the website and its services, and Google processes information needed for its sign-in and other services. These functions are separate from advertising or marketing tracking.
privacy-consent.html.after: Private sign-in and testing areas use necessary session cookies. Cloudflare Turnstile checks website enquiries for spam, and Cloudflare and Google process information needed to provide their respective services. These functions are separate from advertising or marketing tracking.

privacy-consent.html.before: GitHub Actions is used for controlled deployment and migration workflows, which can temporarily process recovery data. GitHub is not the live Portal database, and private production records are not published in the public website repository.
privacy-consent.html.after: To ask about information held about you or a student, request a correction, or discuss retention or deletion, email Amanda at adsouza35@gmail.com. Some information may need to be retained for billing, recordkeeping or other applicable obligations; requests are considered in that context. Please avoid sending sensitive information that is not needed for tutoring.
